judged_text: remove_member uses `group.users.delete(user_id)`, which deletes the join row directly and bypasses the Group membership callbacks (user_count maintenance, automatic-group refresh hooks) that Group#remove goes through. After removing a member the group's cached user_count is stale until refresh_automatic_groups/reload; any logic keyed on user_count (visibility checks, 'groups.visible' behavior, admin UI pagination totals) reports a member count that includes the removed user, and any future callback added to Group#remove (e.g. primary-group downgrade) silently never fires for this path.
